The structure of Li8Al4Cr4O16 (reduced formula Li2AlCrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Al, Cr, and Li centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (one Al, one Cr, two Li). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reports corner- and edge-sharing between Al and Li octahedra, and edge-sharing between Al and Cr octahedra.
